name: Mizoram State Data Centre
developer: Government of Mizoram Department of Information & Communication Technology / NIC
notes: Operational state e-governance data centre in Aizawl; NIC Mizoram page identifies Mizoram State Centre at Treasury Square, Aizawl and describes NIC data centres at state capitals, with page last updated May 30, 2026. DICT page/search result places the State Data Centre at 3rd Floor, Secretariat Building Annex-1, Treasury Square, Aizawl; capacity not disclosed.

name: Mizoram State Data Center cloud enablement upgrade
developer: Government of Mizoram / Ministry of Finance SASCI
notes: Official Mizoram Legislative Assembly proceedings state that the Mizoram e-services portal and upgradation of Mizoram State Data Center & Cloud enablement project under SASCI 2022-2023 was approved for Rs 22.50 crore by the Ministry of Finance. Treated as Aizawl because the existing State Data Centre is documented at Treasury Square, Aizawl; power capacity not disclosed.

name: HybridInternet Champhai data center upgrade
notes: Search-indexed Instagram post says 'Upgrading our data center in Champhai, Mizoram' with HybridInternet hashtags. No independent official or trade-source confirmation found; included as an unverified local telecom/server-room lead, not a confirmed hyperscale or colocation facility.
